title: Social Preview Drift Guard output
description: Per-URL audit results are written to the default dataset. A compact run summary is stored in the OUTPUT record of the default key-value store.

results.title: URL audit results
results.description: One machine-readable audit item per inspected URL, including verdict, risk score, issues, crawler-profile observations, and preview-image checks.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Aggregate PASS/RISK/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE counts and diagnostic summary for the run.
